title: Finite complex circuit: varying L276 gauge saves 344 scalar primitives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Allowing helper L276's dyadic scale to change between uses saves 344 scalar primitives per complex invocation in each orientation of the retained seven-slot k8 word. Eighteen inserted SCALE macros cost 28 primitives per real component and save 200 in coefficient work. The best constant gauge on this same helper saves 74 primitives across both components.

| Complete local word | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Forward | 149,002 | 148,658 |
| Backward | 149,018 | 148,674 |

Status: **finite scalar construction and scoped single-helper optimum**. All original SCALEs and nonscalar events remain, all transitions and work clears are charged, and arbitrary helper dirt is restored. The paid recursive profile is unchanged. No new kappa, measured runtime gain, native hosting admission or formal multiplication theorem is claimed.

The [proof and scope](https://github.com/thakrarsagar/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10f4aaed33d79f76ebdebc974e201b1baad8b8aa/research/k8-varying-gauge-seed37/README.md) explain the all-integer clamping argument and complete invoice. The [certificate](https://github.com/thakrarsagar/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10f4aaed33d79f76ebdebc974e201b1baad8b8aa/research/k8-varying-gauge-seed37/CERTIFICATE.json) records both exact schedules, complete-word hashes and every helper minimum.

## Task and overlap

Base `dd6403f774a0891093a006ae9716c02e371b1fdb`; OS seed 37, complex-supplier track. Scope is a refinement of the donor track, recorded in `research/k8-varying-gauge-seed37/CLAIM.md`. The sorted eligible-helper slice [37:53] has 16 helpers. Both orientations are completed, with arbitrary integer exponents before incident ADDs and a paid return to exponent zero. The original SCALEs stay separately priced. A proof reduces each infinite exponent domain to a finite interval.

- PR1161 at `d210969d3158a1e6c505e41f67dd84e555c88564` covers constant single-helper gauges.
- PR1214 at `26162c56ec9c50a80e49949f36d4dd9a137a76a6` covers two constant gauges and has a larger 576-primitive saving. This PR extends the schedule class; it is not a new best bill across those classes.
- PR1170 at `df273e3cb1e62c1bfdf6599160b538e7a4b879d7` consolidates original stage SCALEs, which this PR retains.
- Concurrent discussion #1258 studies three or more simultaneous constant gauges. No result from it is used or combined here.

Only `research/k8-varying-gauge-seed37/` is added. The refreshed main at `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8` changes none of the seven pinned inputs or selected record. No pinned sprint issue exists, so the claim is local.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/k8-varying-gauge-seed37/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_K8_VARYING_GAUGE_16_HELPERS_NO_NEW_KAPPA helper=276 saved=344/344 columns=712 orientations=2 controls=12`.

Both original and candidate complete words pass all 712 formal columns. A separate distance-transform implementation using literal lowerer costs agrees on all 32 minima. An exhaustive five-node example checks 3,125 schedules. All 326 ADD and 23 SCALE coefficients have exact local-map checks. Prefix magnitude bounds stay at 52/68 bits and conservative coefficient-grid depths at 22/26. Twelve deliberate failures reject, including omitted entry/exit scales, incorrect coefficients/frames, unpaid clearing and broken source pins. A saved-certificate corruption also exits 1.

Passed on macOS arm64 with CPython 3.14.8 normal/optimized and 3.11.17 optimized, including execution outside the checkout. Selected-record integrity, 25 existing selected-record tests and `git diff --check` pass. Native/global cold replay and Linux were not run. All inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit H1-H5 obligations remain.

Philipp / mightyOil's distinct concurrent claim is acknowledged. No independent human review or mechanism-priority claim.

## Open next questions

The smallest useful follow-up is native frame and hosted-supplier admission of this exact L276 word, preserving all 18 paid SCALEs. That integration is still required before production adoption. Joint gauges or SCALE merging would need a separate complete invoice; the unchanged recursive profile supplies no evidence of a kappa gain.
